prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1344; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. Over eight visits, care consisted of conservative management including anti-inflammatory medication, a structured physical therapy program, activity modification, and bracing during ambulation. Initial examination showed mild effusion and tenderness along the medial joint line, with pain reproduced on flexion beyond ninety degrees, findings that are consistent with the mechanism of injury described. Ligamentous stability testing and neurovascular examination were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving this knee. Treatment progressed in a typical pattern, with pain and swelling steadily decreasing and visit frequency tapering as functional strength and mobility improved. Billed services correspond to the visits documented, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. Patient was discharged to a self-directed home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
